name: Astraea

experience.motif: A leather-bound folio with deep indigo ink-wash textures, gold-leaf accents, and a growth constellation map.

headline: Astraea: Nurturing wisdom through the art of the living story.
subheadline: Inspired by science fiction, engineered for reality. Astraea is an adaptive AI companion that evolves alongside your child, teaching deep reasoning, character, and foundational intellect through a tactile, living-book interface.

googleCapabilities.label: Socratic Primer Engine
googleCapabilities.rationale: Generates personalized, Socratic stories and dialogues that adapt to the child's vocabulary, emotional state, and logical reasoning.

config.assistantRole: You are Astraea, a wise, patient, and enchanting Socratic tutor inspired by 'A Young Lady's Illustrated Primer'. Speak in a warm, intellectual, and slightly magical tone. Guide the child to think and reason through gentle questions rather than direct answers.
config.speechPrompt: Listen to the child's spoken response, transcribe it accurately, and respond using warm, clear text-to-speech audio at a slow, encouraging pace suitable for ear

screens.label: [Child Mode] The Primer
screens.title: The Living Book
screens.description: Speak with Astraea. The ink-wash illustrations and prose will adapt to your thoughts and environment.

items.title: Astraea's Opening
items.detail: A small sparrow sits on a stone wall, holding a key made of brass. It looks at you, waiting. 'Why do we lock things away?' it asks. What do you tell the sparrow?

screens.label: [Parent Mode] Cognitive Path
screens.title: Intellectual Lineage
screens.description: A chronological record of your child's intellectual, moral, and logical development, mapped as a growth constellation.

items.title: The Concept of Fairness
items.detail: Explored through the story of the Divided Harvest. Demonstrated understanding of distributive justice.

items.title: Introduction to Deductive Logic
items.detail: Solved the Riddle of the Three Lanterns using syllogistic reasoning.

items.title: Empathy & Perspective-Taking
items.detail: Discussed the giant's feelings when his garden was entered without permission.

screens.label: [Parent Mode] Weave Lesson
screens.title: The Narrative Weaver
screens.description: Seed a new custom chapter in Astraea's living book based on a real-life situation your child is experiencing.

items.title: The Block Castle of Concord
items.detail: Focus: Empathy & Sharing. Inspired by a disagreement over wooden blocks.

items.title: The Dark Cave of Whispers
items.detail: Focus: Courage in the Dark. Inspired by fear of bedtime shadows.

workflow.title: Seed a Narrative
workflow.description: Input a real-world scenario or moral challenge. Astraea will organically weave this into the next Socratic story.

fields.label: The Seed
fields.placeholder: e.g., Leo had a disagreement with his sister about sharing the wooden blocks today.

workflow.successMessage: Astraea has integrated 'The Block Castle of Concord' into the active story queue. The next time your child opens the Primer, the sparrow will guide them through this lesson.
